blindPixelObservations: Portrait frame dominated by saturated orange, yellow, red, black, and dark blue. Bright flame-like textures fill most of the lower half and both lower corners.
The upper half resembles a deep enclosed passage composed of dark vertical panels, dense looping cables, small red lights, and a cool blue-white illuminated region at center.

Two bulky dark upright figure-like forms stand near the center. Each has a bright blue-white point near its upper portion and a long forward projection; bright yellow-orange streams extend from the projections toward the lower-left foreground.
A compact white-and-blue glyph followed by uppercase white text is centered above the main title plaque in the lower-middle region.

A wide near-black title plaque with clipped corners overlaps a larger translucent dark body panel. Thin gold-orange outlines, small projecting tabs, and mirrored diagonal accents articulate the borders.
The body panel is visibly divided into an upper text region and a lower text region. A small gold-brown chamfered plaque containing white uppercase text bridges the central horizontal divider.
The title is one large centered uppercase line. Each body condition occupies one centered line, and the lowest centered line is orange uppercase text.
Orange and cream side accents remain physically continuous with the panel borders and favor decorative framing rather than independent functional glyphs.
